# Hire our venues

The BFI’s central London venues can be hired for screenings, meetings, conferences and events. Our venues include state-of-the-art cinema projection, unrivalled technical presentation and a range of catering spaces.

![](https://core-cms.bfi.org.uk/sites/default/files/styles/responsive/public/2021-11/bfi-southbank-riverfront-external-front-view.jpg/768x432-cropped/bfi-southbank-riverfront-external-front-view.jpg)

BFI Southbank exterior of Riverfront Photograph by Luke Hayes

To hire BFI Southbank, email [[email protected]](https://www.bfi.org.uk/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#46352933322e2427282d2330232832350624202f6829342168332d) or call 020 7849 4461.

To hire BFI Stephen Street, email [[email protected]](https://www.bfi.org.uk/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#52212637223a373c2126203737263724373c26211230343b7c3d20357c2739).

To hire BFI IMAX, email [[email protected]](https://www.bfi.org.uk/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#bac9d5cfced2d8dbd4d1dfccdfd4cec9fad8dcd394d5c8dd94cfd1) or call 020 7849 4461.

## Our venues

### Hiring BFI Southbank

Our riverfront venue by Waterloo Bridge is ideal for film premieres, awards ceremonies, meetings, conferences and private screenings.

[Read Hiring BFI Southbank](https://www.bfi.org.uk/venue-hire/hiring-bfi-southbank "Open Hiring BFI Southbank")

### Hiring BFI Stephen Street

Smart, flexible screening and meeting spaces in the heart of London’s West End with tailored hospitality options from Stephen St Kitchen.

[Read Hiring BFI Stephen Street](https://www.bfi.org.uk/venue-hire/hiring-bfi-stephen-street "Open Hiring BFI Stephen Street")

### Hiring BFI IMAX

BFI IMAX has Britain’s largest cinema screen, and you can hire the entire auditorium to give your event the biggest possible fanfare.

[Read Hiring BFI IMAX](https://www.bfi.org.uk/venue-hire/hiring-bfi-imax "Open Hiring BFI IMAX")

# Hiring BFI Southbank

An outstanding events venue located on the banks of the Thames, BFI Southbank is the national centre for film and the moving image.

![](https://core-cms.bfi.org.uk/sites/default/files/styles/responsive/public/2020-08/bfi-southbank-nft1-interior-shot-with-rainbow-lights.jpg/768x432-cropped/bfi-southbank-nft1-interior-shot-with-rainbow-lights.jpg)

NFT1 at BFI Southbank

[Book your event](https://www.bfi.org.uk/form/bfi-southbank-venue-hire-enquiry)

[Find out about hiring BFI IMAX](https://www.bfi.org.uk/venue-hire/hiring-bfi-imax)

All catering at BFI Southbank is provided by our catering partner Benugo.

# Hiring BFI IMAX

BFI IMAX has Britain’s largest cinema screen, and you can hire the entire auditorium to give your event the biggest possible fanfare.

![](https://core-cms.bfi.org.uk/sites/default/files/styles/responsive/public/2020-08/bfi-imax-interior-shot-screen-and-viewers.jpeg/768x432-cropped/bfi-imax-interior-shot-screen-and-viewers.jpeg)

BFI Imax

[Book your event](https://www.bfi.org.uk/form/bfi-imax-venue-hire-enquiry)

The 20 x 26m screen and 500-capacity luxury auditorium is perfect for major film premieres, product launches and awards ceremonies. Upstairs, the first floor foyer is a brilliant space for receptions, photoshoots, product launches and other functions.

## BFI IMAX facilities

BFI IMAX is:

- fully licensed to serve alcoholic drinks and air-conditioned.
- able to use IMAX 2D and 3D, 70mm and 35mm film projectors.
- located one minute from London Waterloo train and Underground stations.
- available for daytime and evening hire

## BFI IMAX auditorium

The BFI IMAX auditorium has 500 seats in 15 rows of seats, including ones with wheelchair access, so everyone can clearly see the screen.

As well as having the biggest screen in Britain, it’s also one of the best equipped for sound and projection technology, and you can set up temporary stages in front of the screen to introduce your event.

## BFI IMAX ground floor

The ground floor at BFI IMAX is a great space for a reception, with capacity for 450 guests standing or 200 seated for dinner.

We’ve hosted events here for Disney, Warner Bros, Hachette and London Business Forum.

## BFI IMAX first floor

The first floor foyer can be adapted for launch events, dinner parties, brand presentations or receptions for up to 450 people.

With our suppliers we can take care of all the catering for your event – get in touch and we’ll arrange a free tasting session for you.

# Screenings

Hold a press, industry or private screening at BFI Stephen Street or BFI Southbank.

![View from the back of BFI Southbank NFT1, in which rows of people sit in red cinema-style seating, full length curtains are lit up with rainbow coloured lighting and cover the large cinema screen.](https://core-cms.bfi.org.uk/sites/default/files/styles/responsive/public/2021-10/bfi-southbank-nft1-interior-shot-with-rainbow-lights-and-audience.jpg/768x432-cropped/bfi-southbank-nft1-interior-shot-with-rainbow-lights-and-audience.jpg)

BFI Southbank NFT1 during BFI Flare Festival

## BFI Southbank

There is no better place to feel part of screen history than at the iconic [BFI Southbank](https://www.bfi.org.uk/venue-hire/hiring-bfi-southbank "Hiring BFI Southbank").

We offer private screening room hire in our central London auditoriums – where many famous movie moments first screened in the UK – offering theatre-style seating for between 38 and 450 guests.

Each of our cinema screens has a corresponding reception area for hire, and if you pair NFT1 with the stunning Riverfront and its Terrace, you get the benefit of stylish outdoor space overlooking the Thames.

Clients tell us they keep coming back because of the expertise of our technical support, the commitment of our event coordination team and the flexibility the building offers with branding opportunities.

Contact the [Southbank events team](https://www.bfi.org.uk/form/bfi-southbank-venue-hire-enquiry) or telephone 020 7849 4461 to tell us about your event and how we can help.

## BFI Stephen Street

[BFI Stephen Street](https://www.bfi.org.uk/venue-hire/hiring-bfi-stephen-street "Hiring BFI Stephen Street") is home to two incredible screening rooms, each seating 36 guests.

The space is perfect for intimate screenings, technical checks, industry rushes, and interviews and filming requiring a cinematic backdrop on a small budget.

Available by the hour, half- or full-day, as well as by evening, we can play formats from DCP to 16mm film.

[BFI Stephen Street screening rooms technical specificationsPDF49 KB](https://core-cms.bfi.org.uk/media/11/download)

## What can be screened at the BFI

We can screen any title, including your own film, but films owned by third parties will need to have screening rights cleared.

Screening rights may incur a cost, as might the hire of a suitable print of the film to screen.

For a list of titles the BFI holds take a look at the [BFI distribution catalogue](https://www.bfi.org.uk/distribution/film_format/dcp).

Please note, we cannot hire out spaces to clients for public screenings. All private auditorium hire at the BFI must be for private audiences.

## How to book

BFI Stephen Street can accommodate very short notice bookings, including same-day.

Email [[email protected]](https://www.bfi.org.uk/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#0c7f78697c6469627f787e696978697a6962787f4c6e6a6522637e6b227967) or telephone  020 7957 4777.

For daytime bookings at BFI Southbank we recommend at least one month’s notice and evening hires require at least five months’ notice.

Contact the [Southbank events team](https://www.bfi.org.uk/form/bfi-southbank-venue-hire-enquiry) or telephone 020 7849 4461.

## Rates and charges

Venue hire charges differ depending on which space you require, how long you need the space for and the specific requirements of your event. Please [use our contact form](https://www.bfi.org.uk/form/bfi-southbank-venue-hire-enquiry) to get a quote for your event.

All rates include:

• the use of the in-house AV equipment

• the assistance of a BFI Events Coordinator

• a projectionist

NFT1, NFT2 and NFT3 bookings include an usher.

We can also quote for additions such as a cloakroom and cloakroom staff, and additional security should they be required. All catering enquiries and ordering are dealt with by Benugo at BFI Southbank and by Stephen St Kitchen at BFI Stephen Street.
